record.paper_title: Several Open Problems on Banach Spaces (Castro Urdiales 2014)
record.original_question: Does there exist a real Banach space X that is not isomorphic to its hyperplanes, such that X has complex structure and its hyperplanes also have complex structure? Here a real Banach space has complex structure when it admits a bounded operator J with J^2 = -I.

artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in a 2014 collection of open problems on Banach spaces from Castro Urdiales. No published resolution was found in the search; related questions about complex structure on hyperplanes and the hyperplane problem (Gowers) remain active topics, but this specific combined question seems to remain open.
